cohort: The study included all pregnant females admitted with suspicion of placental abruption at 28 weeks gestation and above, in a tertiary care hospital in Delhi between January 01, 2019 and December 31, 2024.
finding: Preeclampsia/eclampsia, diabetes, previous caesarean section, premature rupture of the membrane, multigravida, and multiparity were identified as significant risk factors for abruptio placentae, which in turn was associated with substantial maternal and adverse fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a maternal complication of abruptio placentae, with an OR of 2.76.
followup_time: N/A (outcomes measured during pregnancy and immediately post-delivery)
